title: Viva Glint: announcement icon in the product header for service administrators
notes: claim 30: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The briefing passes: the planned header link, roadmap details, product licensing and administrator assignment path are supported. Microsoft recommends no more than five service administrators but does not establish that this is the typical number; the email-notification and sender-allowlisting checklist steps also have no corresponding control rows.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: Viva Glint blog notifications use notifications@communityhub.microsoft.com, which Microsoft advises allowlisting if necessary.

claims.where: rationale: impact
claims.claim: Viva Glint service administrators are typically no more than five people.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Service Administrator role assign Microsoft Graph PowerShell API; "Viva Glint" "Service Administrator" "Graph". Opened post-provisioning-next-steps and read role-definitions excerpts. They recommend no more than five admins, not an observed typical population.
claims.fix: Remove ', who are the owners of the app and typically no more than five people' from the impact rationale. The remaining sentence is: 'Low. Only Viva Glint service administrators are named as seeing the icon.'

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The checklist directs readers to configure blog email notifications, but the controls table has no row for that control.
claims.quote: At rollout: 'follow the blog and turn on Get Email Notifications.' The table contains only Service Administrator assignment and the absent announcement-icon hiding switch.
claims.fix: The At rollout notification-setting step has no control row. Narrow it to reference-only advice: 'Point administrators who want email alerts to the Viva Glint newsletter page.'

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The checklist directs readers to change an approved sender list, but the controls table has no allowlisting row.
claims.quote: After rollout: 'Add notifications@communityhub.microsoft.com to your approved sender list if administrators report that blog emails do not arrive.' Neither table row covers an approved sender list.
claims.fix: The After rollout approved-sender-list step has no control row. Replace it with: 'Refer administrators whose blog emails do not arrive to the Not receiving notifications? section of the Viva Glint newsletter page.'
